intent: A courtly cliff-valkyrie gown in pale sky blue and cloud white — a light steel breastplate over a warm tan sash, a closed tiered pennant skirt that bells from hip to ankle, and a winged hood with a wide scarf streaming back — reading from the high camera as a slim blue top over a bright, full bell.
requests: A tapered or wedge-cut skirt panel: box panels can only step wider, so the bell is built from tiers rather than one clean flare.
A rippled or scalloped hem piece to make the pennant hems feel wind-caught; box hems stay straight.
